# IMPERIA COLD WAR: War Measures v3 (24.11.2026): crimes, evidence, exposure, observers, peacekeepers.

# ROOT = the country that sends the action, THIS = the target.
scripted_diplomatic_actions = {
	COLDWAR_OBS_send = {
		allowed = { always = yes }
		cost = 100
		icon = 1
		visible = {
			ROOT = { COLDWAR_OBS_human = yes }
			NOT = { tag = ROOT }
			NOT = { is_in_array = { array = COLDWAR_OBS_missions value = ROOT } }
		}
		selectable = {
			custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = COLDWAR_OBS_tt_players COLDWAR_OBS_human = yes }
			custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = COLDWAR_OBS_tt_host COLDWAR_OBS_host_state_ok = yes }
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = COLDWAR_OBS_tt_neutral
				NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT }
				NOT = { any_enemy_country = { has_war_with = ROOT } }
			}
			custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = COLDWAR_OBS_tt_host_limit NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_OBS_missions^num > 3 } } }
			custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = COLDWAR_OBS_tt_sender_limit ROOT = { NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_OBS_hosts^num > 1 } } } }
		}
		requires_acceptance = yes
		can_be_accepted = { always = yes }
		complete_effect = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: observer mission to [This.GetName] accepted"
			add_to_array = { COLDWAR_OBS_missions = ROOT }
			ROOT = {
				add_to_array = { COLDWAR_OBS_hosts = PREV }
				add_intel = { target = PREV civilian_intel = 10 army_intel = 10 }
			}
			every_enemy_country = { ROOT = { add_intel = { target = PREV army_intel = 10 } } }
			COLDWAR_OBS_recalc = yes
			ROOT = { COLDWAR_OBS_recalc = yes }
		}
		reject_effect = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: observer mission to [This.GetName] refused"
		}
		send_description = COLDWAR_OBS_send_send
		receive_description = COLDWAR_OBS_send_receive
		accept_title = COLDWAR_OBS_send_accept_t
		accept_description = COLDWAR_OBS_send_accept_d
		reject_title = COLDWAR_OBS_send_reject_t
		reject_description = COLDWAR_OBS_send_reject_d
		ai_desire = { base = -1000 }
		ai_acceptance = { base_desire = { base = -1000 } }
	}
	COLDWAR_OBS_end = {
		allowed = { always = yes }
		cost = 0
		icon = 17
		visible = {
			OR = {
				is_in_array = { array = COLDWAR_OBS_missions value = ROOT }
				ROOT = { is_in_array = { array = COLDWAR_OBS_missions value = PREV } }
			}
		}
		requires_acceptance = no
		complete_effect = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: observer mission with [This.GetName] ended"
			remove_from_array = { COLDWAR_OBS_missions = ROOT }
			remove_from_array = { COLDWAR_OBS_hosts = ROOT }
			ROOT = {
				remove_from_array = { COLDWAR_OBS_missions = PREV }
				remove_from_array = { COLDWAR_OBS_hosts = PREV }
				COLDWAR_OBS_recalc = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_OBS_recalc = yes
		}
		send_description = COLDWAR_OBS_end_send
		accept_title = COLDWAR_OBS_end_t
		accept_description = COLDWAR_OBS_end_d
		ai_desire = { base = -1000 }
	}
	COLDWAR_PK_send = {
		allowed = { always = yes }
		cost = 100
		icon = 23
		visible = {
			ROOT = { COLDWAR_OBS_human = yes }
			NOT = { tag = ROOT }
			NOT = { is_in_array = { array = COLDWAR_PK_senders value = ROOT } }
		}
		selectable = {
			custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = COLDWAR_OBS_tt_players COLDWAR_OBS_human = yes }
			custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = COLDWAR_PK_tt_not_enemy NOT = { has_war_with = ROOT } }
			custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = COLDWAR_PK_tt_money ROOT = { check_variable = { treasury > 2 } } }
			ROOT = { has_manpower > 14999 }
		}
		requires_acceptance = yes
		can_be_accepted = { always = yes }
		complete_effect = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: peacekeepers to [This.GetName] accepted"
			add_to_array = { COLDWAR_PK_senders = ROOT }
			give_military_access = ROOT
			ROOT = {
				add_to_array = { COLDWAR_PK_hosts = PREV }
				add_manpower = -15000
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -2 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				COLDWAR_PK_prepare_uniform_template = yes
				COLDWAR_PK_recalc = yes
				save_global_event_target_as = COLDWAR_PK_news_sender
				set_variable = { COLDWAR_PK_new_host = PREV }
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_PK.4 }
			}
			save_global_event_target_as = COLDWAR_PK_news_host
			every_country = { limit = { exists = yes } news_event = { id = COLDWAR_PK.1 hours = 6 } }
		}
		reject_effect = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: peacekeepers to [This.GetName] refused"
		}
		send_description = COLDWAR_PK_send_send
		receive_description = COLDWAR_PK_send_receive
		accept_title = COLDWAR_PK_send_accept_t
		accept_description = COLDWAR_PK_send_accept_d
		reject_title = COLDWAR_PK_send_reject_t
		reject_description = COLDWAR_PK_send_reject_d
		ai_desire = { base = -1000 }
		ai_acceptance = { base_desire = { base = -1000 } }
	}
	COLDWAR_PK_end = {
		allowed = { always = yes }
		cost = 0
		icon = 17
		visible = {
			OR = {
				is_in_array = { array = COLDWAR_PK_senders value = ROOT }
				ROOT = { is_in_array = { array = COLDWAR_PK_senders value = PREV } }
			}
		}
		requires_acceptance = no
		complete_effect = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: peacekeeping with [This.GetName] ended"
			if = {
				limit = { is_in_array = { array = COLDWAR_PK_senders value = ROOT } }
				# the sender withdraws
				set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_PK_end_kind = 1 }
				ROOT = { save_event_target_as = COLDWAR_PK_snd save_global_event_target_as = COLDWAR_PK_news_sender }
				save_global_event_target_as = COLDWAR_PK_news_host
				COLDWAR_PK_end_mission = yes
			}
			else = {
				# the host asks them to leave
				set_variable = { global.COLDWAR_PK_end_kind = 2 }
				save_event_target_as = COLDWAR_PK_snd
				save_global_event_target_as = COLDWAR_PK_news_sender
				ROOT = { save_global_event_target_as = COLDWAR_PK_news_host COLDWAR_PK_end_mission = yes }
			}
			every_country = { limit = { exists = yes } news_event = { id = COLDWAR_PK.2 hours = 6 } }
		}
		send_description = COLDWAR_PK_end_send
		accept_title = COLDWAR_PK_end_t
		accept_description = COLDWAR_PK_end_d
		ai_desire = { base = -1000 }
	}
}
